_comment: Captured from a live run of the unmodified pm/tab-manager-registry build (4778ac2) — a real browser driven through create_session, tabManager.openFile and tabManager.openModule, then a dump of the four localStorage keys. This is the back-compat gate for the whole pane-registry refactor (spec section H): every handoff from 1 through 9 must restore this fixture identically. {{SESSION_ID}}, {{PROJECT_ID}} and {{TS}} are substituted by test/e2e/tab-panes.spec.js at seed time (a fixed session/project id and Date.now(), so the fixture stays inside the 24h TTL on every run) — the field NAMES and SHAPES either side of the substitution are the literal captured output, unedited. See §H of /tmp/eve-phase4-tab-manager-spec.md: eve-open-sessions is deliberately a bare number, not an object; eve-session-meta is the only place sessionType survives a reload, since GET /api/sessions (relayLLM) has no concept of it.
